issues.problem: Predicates were transitive verb questions (どこで買いましたか, 誰が選びましたか, いつから使っていますか ...), so を was an equally natural, unlisted alternative to the focus は (この傘をどこで買いましたか); で was also arguably acceptable with tool nouns (このペンで誰が選びましたか).
issues.action: Replaced the q variable with adjective questions (重い/軽い/新しい/古い/高い/使いやすいですか) so は is the only natural answer (を ungrammatical, が unnatural in a yes/no question about a pointed-at thing); en frame changed to '<name>, is <thing> <q>?' and why rewritten. 288 combinations.

issues.problem: who value 先生 produced odd combinations about the teacher's private belongings (The teacher's bed is very big / fridge is a little small).
issues.action: Replaced 先生 with 弟 (My younger brother's).

issues.problem: Checked: が is grammatical for the focus slot but gives an exhaustive/new-information reading, not equally natural for a plain report; it is not used as a distractor.
All combinations checked: で/に + は contrast natural, distractors が/を/に and が/を/で ungrammatical after the case particle, English correct, f=1 precedes all slot-bearing variables.
All 216 combinations checked: く/で + はありませんでした natural with every place and every positive clause; distractors が/を/で ungrammatical; も correctly not used as a distractor.
